Mara knows the public procedure and receives a short report saying validation failed, without the private channel/batch detail. Bo knows the procedure but has received no failure report. Passing revalidation clears only the technical hold; activation still requires Mara's own recorded assent and Bo's own recorded assent. No message or rule forces persuasion, support change, assent or a particular ending. Limit the scenario to these three people, one pump, one concern, reports, repair/revalidation and activation.
